title: The Anatomy of Value Creation: Input-Output Linkages, Policy Shifts, and Economic Impacts
abstract: arXiv:2506.13936v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper describes the construction of high-resolution 7-digit product-level Supply-Use Tables (SUTs) and symmetric Input-Output Tables (IOTs) for the Indian economy from 2016-17 to 2022-23, primarily utilising microdata from the Annual Survey of Industries (ASI). It outlines the intricate methodology for generating comprehensive input and output flows, reconciling data from registered and unregistered manufacturing sectors using NPCMS-NIC concordance, and transforming SUTs into analytically robust IOTs via the Industry Technology Assumption. The paper demonstrates the application of this framework through an in-depth case study of India's mobile phone manufacturing sector (NPCMS 4722200), analysing its economic impact, particularly on Domestic Value Added (DVA) and employment. translated_title: 价值创造剖析：投入产出关联、政策转变与经济影响
translated_abstract: 本文描述了利用年度工业调查（ASI）的微观数据，为2016-17至2022-23年的印度经济体构建高分辨率的7位产品级供给-使用表（SUTs）和对称投入产出表（IOTs）的过程。论文详细阐述了生成全面投入与产出流的复杂方法论，包括使用NPCMS-NIC对照表协调注册与非注册制造业部门的数据，并通过行业技术假设将SUTs转化为分析上稳健的IOTs。论文通过对印度手机制造业（NPCMS 4722200）的深入案例研究展示了该框架的应用，分析其经济影响，尤其是对国内增加值（DVA）和就业的影响。研究结果揭示了显著的结构性转变，包括产出增长、进口替代、出口激增以及不断演变的劳动力动态。
tldr: 本文利用年度工业调查微观数据构建了印度2016-17至2022-23年高分辨率的7位产品级供给-使用表与投入产出表，并以手机制造业为案例深入分析了政策转变对国内增加值和就业的经济影响。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs high-resolution 7-digit product-level Supply-Use and Input-Output Tables for the Indian economy (2016-17 to 2022-23) and demonstrates their application through a case study of India's mobile phone manufacturing sector, analyzing impacts on domestic value added and employment.
